title: Get a Driver's Licence & Register a Vehicle
description: The sequential compliance steps to obtain a Ghanaian driver's licence, register motor vehicles, and obtain statutory roadworthiness inspection certificates at the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Authority (DVLA).

steps.title: Biometric Identity Verification with NIA
steps.why: The DVLA mandates that all applicants for new driver's licences, licence upgrades, and vehicle registrations must link an active Ghana Card.
steps.do_this_when: Before booking any driver's training course or registering a vehicle.

options.label: National Identification Authority Portal
options.notes: Verify your biometric national identification before DVLA appointments.

steps.title: Apply for Driver's Licence & Schedule CBT Exam
steps.why: All new drivers must undergo eye screening, computerized theory testing (CBT), and an in-traffic practical driving test administered by DVLA examiners.
steps.do_this_when: After completing mandatory certified driving school hours.

options.label: DVLA Online Services Portal
options.notes: Official portal for driver's licence application, appointment booking, and renewal.

steps.title: Complete Vehicle Registration & Plate Allocation
steps.why: All imported and newly purchased vehicles must be formally registered and assigned official Ghanaian number plates and logbooks (Form V).
steps.do_this_when: Upon clearing vehicle customs at port or acquiring a new vehicle.

options.label: DVLA Vehicle Registration Services
options.notes: Guidelines and requirements for vehicle registration and number plate issuance.

steps.title: Undergo Roadworthiness Inspection
steps.why: Statutory inspection to ensure vehicles meet safety and emissions standards; roadworthiness decals must be renewed annually (or biannually for commercial transport).
steps.do_this_when: Immediately following vehicle registration or upon annual expiry.

options.label: Roadworthiness Certificate Inspection
options.notes: Checklist for physical and computerized vehicle inspection centers.

steps.title: Vehicle Ownership Transfer (Purchasing Used Vehicles)
steps.why: Legally transfers title and liability from previous owner to buyer to update national vehicle records.
steps.do_this_when: When purchasing a pre-owned vehicle registered in Ghana.

options.label: DVLA Vehicle Ownership Transfer Service
options.notes: Procedure for buyer and seller appearance and logbook endorsement.

steps.title: National Road Safety Authority (NRSA) Training Accreditation
steps.why: Regulates commercial driving schools, road safety transport operators, and driver training certification under Act 993.
steps.do_this_when: When registering a driving school or commercial transport fleet.

options.label: National Road Safety Authority Portal
options.notes: Guidelines for driver training schools and road safety operator permits.

steps.title: GPHA Port Access & Vehicle Cargo Clearance
steps.why: Vehicles imported via Tema or Takoradi ports must obtain port security clearance, berth gate passes, and GPHA terminal release.
steps.do_this_when: When importing vehicles by shipping container or roll-on/roll-off (RoRo).

options.label: Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority Services
options.notes: Port entry permits, terminal tariff clearance, and cargo release.
